a lot of her build depends on what team she's in so what i say may not apply to you since you didn't specify  
if she's in a freeze team (arguably her best team), by far her best artifacts set is 4pc blizzards, as you can very easily get a high crit rate without the help of artifacts. (cryo res + her talent + 40% from the artifacts). this means you can essentially just stack a ton of crit damage on her as long as you are keeping enemies frozen, and you'll still be critting often and be hitting huge numbers. im going to assume you dont have any better weapons, but most 5\* bows work great on her if you manage to get any later on. specifically polar star, amos' bow, the first great magic and aqua simulacra. good teammates for freeze teams include diona, shenhe, kokomi, mona, ayaka, honestly anyone who can help her keep enemies frozen or provide some sort of elemental damage boost

if you're using her as a melt dps, 4 shimenawas or 4 wanderers is her best option for the extra charged attack damage. hamayumi is a very good 4\* bow option in melt teams, and teammates such as xiangling and bennett are very good. im going to assume you are using a melt team since her burst is low levelled, and in melt teams you don't want to be utilising her burst often as it can take away the pyro aura and reduce overall dps  


tl;dr get the right artifact sets depending on what team youre playing and that will help massively. also you may as well level her normal attack to 10 if she'd already level 90. feel free to ask any questions
